about.label: About
about.description1: Dubai Communicates in Sign Language is a forward-thinking initiative from the Community Development Authority, designed to build a more inclusive and connected society. Our mission is to empower the community with Emirati Sign Language, breaking down communication barriers and ensuring every individual, including People of Determination, can engage fully in our city's vibrant life.
about.description2: This initiative provides tools and opportunities to foster direct, meaningful communication across all segments of society.

mission.label: Vision
mission.title: Our Strategic Mission
mission.description: Dubai Communicates in Sign Language is driven by a clear commitment to progress, guided by four core pillars:
mission.pillar1Desc: Aligned with the Dubai Social Agenda 33, the initiative reinforces Dubai's reputation as a global leader in social innovation and inclusion for People of Determination.
mission.pillar2Desc: Participants will take part in a unified virtual lesson delivered by experts from the Deaf Community, ensuring authentic, high-quality instruction in Emirati Sign Language.
mission.pillar3Desc: The initiative aims to set a Guinness World Record for the largest virtual sign language lesson, amplifying Dubai's message of inclusion on the global arena.
mission.pillar4Desc: Government entities, private sector partners, and educational institutions come together to create long-term, city-wide impact through collaboration.

missionCards.card1Desc: We envision a Dubai where communication is seamless and accessible to everyone. A city where Emirati Sign Language is widely understood and used, enriching daily interactions and opening new opportunities for conversation. This vision is rooted in respect for diversity and a shared responsibility to improve quality of life for all residents.
missionCards.card2Desc: Sign language is a complete and powerful form of communication. As a visual language, it expresses complex ideas with clarity and depth, independent of sound. By enabling direct communication, sign language builds genuine understanding, strengthens relationships, and plays a vital role in creating an inclusive society.
